settings.title: Sieve
settings.description: Excludes files and folders before vault indexing
settings.rulesDescription: Paths are relative to the vault root. The first matching rule wins.
settings.syntaxSummary: One rule per line. * matches characters within a name; ** also crosses folders. Prefix ! to include matching paths. Start a comment line with //.
settings.displayNameDescription: Leave empty to use the root folder name.

messages.includeRepeatedError: File {path} is included more than once
messages.escapePositionError: The #escape directive must precede filter rules
messages.unsupportedVersion: This version of Obsidian does not support Sieve filtering
messages.configurationError: Could not load Sieve settings. The vault will open without filtering.
messages.fallbackUsed: Could not load the saved rules. The previous working rules will be used.
messages.runtimeError: Could not complete Sieve filtering. Reopen the vault.
messages.externalError: Could not validate the saved Sieve settings
